purpose: Bind a post-training data comparison that measures verified supervision value and conditional RL prompt feasibility from the same useful parent.

common_contract.parent: SFT arms start from the same useful parent checkpoint with model and tokenizer identities hash-bound. RL feasibility uses the selected SFT checkpoint and does not update policy weights.
common_contract.sft: Fresh optimizer and paired data-order seeds; same task and length strata, chat serialization, assistant-only masks, schedule, supervised-token target and evaluation identities.
common_contract.rl: Fixed-policy prompt, rollout and verifier feasibility only. No policy optimization or RL training-data ablation is promised by this packet.
common_contract.context: Train only within the qualified context ceiling. Complete conversations are required; no silent truncation or fabricated reasoning/tool observations.
common_contract.accounting: Count source preparation, teacher/reference generation, validation, rejected rows, retries, rollouts, scoring, training and allocated idle time separately and once.
common_contract.evaluation: Keep task families, source families and final tests disjoint from every training, teacher-generation and prompt-selection path.

arms.role: Eligible baseline selection from the common candidate pool
arms.contract: Use the predeclared task, length and category strata without outcome-verification selection.

arms.role: Outcome-verification selection from the same candidate pool
arms.contract: Select using independent code/math/tool outcome evidence while preserving the same strata, parent, serialization, mask and supervised-token target. Report selection-induced task and length differences.

sft.primary_endpoint: Predeclared held-out code, math or tool-task success metric matching the selection intervention.
efficiency_endpoints: Success and retention per supervised token and allocated GPU-hour
SFT loss area and steps to a fixed development target
Reasoning length, assistant-token density and context-token exposure
Preparation, verification, teacher/reference and rejected-row cost
guardrails: Tool-call schema validity and unresolved-call rate

rl_feasibility.parent: Selected SFT checkpoint after the SFT comparison, or a documented baseline-only outcome.
rl_feasibility.scope: Sample candidate math and sandboxed-code prompt strata; run fixed-policy rollouts and verifiers with no gradient updates.
required_evidence: Pinned prompt families and held-out references/tests
Verifier validity, deliberately wrong controls and failure reasons
Rollout length, tool-step, retry and environment recovery cost
Agreement between in-environment outcomes and held-out task transfer
primary_outputs: Verifier pass validity and non-vacuous success/failure groups
Prompt difficulty and rollout cost distribution
Fixed-policy success, failure and recovery curves
Decision on whether policy-training infrastructure is justified
rl_feasibility.boundary: This slot does not fund an RL data comparison, policy updates or a production RL commitment.

support_and_reserve.budget_check: 100 SFT comparison + 20 RL feasibility + 30 support = 150 post-training-research GPU-hours.

required_gates_before_first_arm: Useful parent, tokenizer/chat format and checkpoint identities are hash-bound.
SFT rows pass source-use, task-family, exact/near-duplicate and final-evaluation partition gates.
Complete conversations, assistant masks, supervised-token counts and context ceilings are measured without truncation.
Outcome-verification selection uses independent checks and records rejected, unresolved and invalid cases.
RL prompts, references/tests, environments and verifiers are pinned and pass non-vacuous controls.
SFT and fixed-policy evaluation cost fits the 150-hour research reservation; production exposure remains separate.
required_outputs_for_report: Manifest fields, quality-weighted coverage distributions, lineage and contamination status under the shared data-design contract.
Unique tasks, source families, total/context/supervised tokens and reasoning lengths by arm.
Per-arm success, retention, convergence and cost curves with paired-seed variation.
Outcome-verification coverage, unresolved cases and false-positive/negative controls.
Fixed-policy RL feasibility, verifier reliability, rollout failures and environment cost.
Negative, inconclusive and baseline-only outcomes with the same detail as selected results.
boundary: No post-training arm is launch-ready from this packet. It defines SFT data selection and conditional RL feasibility only; a future launch must bind a useful parent, qualified manifests, chat/mask fingerprints, evaluation partitions, verifier/runtime receipts and an explicit launch receipt.
